Quick Rules
What PestBlok™ Does
Corrugated Exclusion Strips seal open gaps at ridges and lower edges on metal roof panels. Each strip covers ~3 linear feet.
Standing Seam = Top Only
The standing seam bottom edge is already closed. This tool only offers a Top (ridge) SKU for SS panels.
Need spot blocking?
Switch to the Rib Blok™ tab for blocking individual rib cavities where a full strip won't fit.

About Rib Blok™
What Rib Blok™ Does
Rib Blok™ inserts fill individual rib cavities where a full PestBlok™ strip won't fit. Perfect for spot blocking tight spaces.
1 Insert Per Rib
Count every open rib gap you want to seal. Each gap = 1 insert. Packs contain 30 inserts.
No Standing Seam
Standing Seam panels have a fully closed seam — no rib blocking needed. Use PestBlok™ Top strip instead.
